201.description: The reservation and the presigned target to send the bytes to.

documentId.description: Identifies the reservation; completion names it in the path.

kind.description: The upload mechanism. `post-form` is a multipart form POST to `url` that carries every entry of `fields` before the file part, as a presigned POST requires.

url.description: The object store endpoint to POST the form to.

fields.description: Form fields to send verbatim, before the file part.

expiresAt.description: When the presigned target stops accepting the upload. Complete before then.

400.description:
The body or query violates its declared shape; `message` names each violated rule.

`INVALID_DOCUMENT_UPLOAD`: The reservation or completion is not acceptable: the current step has no such upload field, the content type, size or image dimensions fall outside what the field allows, or the completion body is not empty.

oneOf.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
oneOf.title: NestHttpError

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

404.description:
`DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND`: No onboarding has this id, or no reservation with this document id belongs to it.

`WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND`: No published workflow has this id, or no revision of it carries the pinned version.
